chunks: 4983 - And in the narration of Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:

"Three people Allah will not speak to on the Day of Judgment, nor will He look at them, nor will He purify them, and for them is a painful punishment: the old man who commits adultery, the dayyūth, and the woman who lets her husband's bed be approached."

key_terms.عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ: a painful punishment in the hereafter
key_terms.فِرَاشَ زَوْجِهَا: her husband's marital bed, signifying marital sanctity
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when people are called to account
key_terms.ٱلدَّيُّوثُ: a man lacking protective jealousy over the honor of his household
key_terms.ٱلشَّيْخُ ٱلزَّانِي: an elderly man who commits adultery or fornication

ai.seo_question: Which people are described as not being spoken to or purified by Allah on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith warns of severe punishment in the afterlife for three categories linked to grave sexual immorality and the violation of family honor. It emphasizes that such acts are not merely private sins, but serious moral and social corruptions with consequences on the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4983 - In the narration of Ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:

"Three types of people Allah (swt) will not speak to on the Day of Judgment, nor will He (swt) look at them, nor will He (swt) purify them, and for them is a painful punishment: an old man who commits adultery, a cuckold (a man who has no sense of honor regarding his family), and a woman who allows another man to violate the sanctity of her husband's bed."
